cases.case_label: AluSb1 in intron 7 of FAS causing exon 8 skipping
cases.mechanism_detail: A 331-bp Alu (AluSb1-like, 34-bp polyA, 17-bp TSD) in FAS intron 7 led to an mRNA lacking exon 8 without loss of a splice junction; father and son heterozygous, with defective Fas-mediated apoptosis.
cases.quote: Both patients were heterozygous for the mutated allele that produced Fas mRNA lacking exon 8, although not due to loss of a splice junction.
